connector.name: Magellan Data Spotlight
connector.registryDescription: Find parent companies, PE backers, corporate families, and portfolio siblings for any company.
connector.summary: Hosted at spotlight-mcp.magellandata.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.magellandata, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your Magellan Data API key (mgln_sk_live_...), generated in the Spotlight dashboard.
